endowment_summary: Developed deep WebGL expertise at Brown, created a water simulation demo that WIRED called one of the best of the year. Strong technical ability with graphics programming, though not a traditional prodigy.
inherited_summary: Limited public information on family background. Brown University access suggests a stable, at least middle-class upbringing.
ecosystem_summary: Met Dylan Field at Brown University CS department. Their cofounder partnership became Figma. Brown CS peer group and the emerging browser-based graphics ecosystem at the right time.
